appointments_window_check.name: appointments_window_check
appointments_window_check.value: "end_at" IS NULL OR "start_at" IS NOT NULL

appointments_window_order_check.name: appointments_window_order_check
appointments_window_order_check.value: "end_at" IS NULL OR "start_at" IS NULL OR "end_at" > "start_at"

machine_assignments_machine_status_check.name: machine_assignments_machine_status_check
machine_assignments_machine_status_check.value: ("status" = 'open' AND "machine_id" IS NULL) OR ("status" <> 'open' AND "machine_id" IS NOT NULL)

damage_markers_area_check.name: damage_markers_area_check
damage_markers_area_check.value: ("marker_type" = 'point' AND "width" IS NULL AND "height" IS NULL) OR ("marker_type" = 'area' AND "width" > 0 AND "height" > 0 AND "x" + "width" <= 1 AND "y" + "height" <= 1)

missing_accessory_cases_resolved_check.name: missing_accessory_cases_resolved_check
missing_accessory_cases_resolved_check.value: "status" <> 'resolved' OR ("resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "resolved_by" IS NOT NULL)

rental_returns_finalized_check.name: rental_returns_finalized_check
rental_returns_finalized_check.value: "status" <> 'finalized' OR ("finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "actual_return_at" IS NOT NULL AND "original_actual_return_at" IS NOT NULL AND "protocol_document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "returner_phone" IS NULL)

return_machines_cleanup_check.name: return_machines_cleanup_check
return_machines_cleanup_check.value: ("cleanup_required" = false AND "cleanup_fee_snapshot_cents" IS NULL) OR ("cleanup_required" = true AND "cleanup_fee_snapshot_cents" > 0)

offline_mutation_receipts_error_check.name: offline_mutation_receipts_error_check
offline_mutation_receipts_error_check.value: ("offline_mutation_receipts"."status"::text IN ('applied', 'processing') AND "offline_mutation_receipts"."error_code" IS NULL) OR ("offline_mutation_receipts"."status"::text NOT IN ('applied', 'processing') AND "offline_mutation_receipts"."error_code" IS NOT NULL)

accounting_transfers_target_check.name: accounting_transfers_target_check
accounting_transfers_target_check.value: ("kind" = 'settlement' AND "settlement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cancellation_id" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'cancellation' AND "cancellation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "settlement_id" IS NULL)
